text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono— Would you care to go flower 
viewing with me after school tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The cherry blossoms by the outdoor stage 
looked to be in full bloom. That is, of 
course, only if your schedule allows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting her invitation made me realize 
that because I had been so focused on work 
lately, I hadn't been paying any attention 
to the scenery around me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the next day— Just as Yaeno 
Muteki had said, the cherry blossoms on 
the outdoor stage were in magnificent, 
full bloom."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the spirit of flower viewing, I have 
prepared a boxed lunch. I do hope it suits 
your taste...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...! I'm so glad it was to your 
liking.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I based it on my grandmother's 
recipe. She used to pack it for me 
whenever I went on hiking trips that 
doubled as training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am honored that this taste of memories 
could help you enjoy the cherry blossom 
viewing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Please spend today relaxing. You've 
seemed a bit tense lately."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of your diligence, but 
resting your mind and body from time to 
time is also important.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. Now then, let us enjoy the 
cherry blossom viewing to our heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I was captivated by her gentle 
smile— cherry blossom petals carried by 
the wind came flying straight at my face.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Take this!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. M-My sincerest apologies! I was 
just so intent on protecting you, Trainer, 
that I...
choice_data_list:
You caught a flower petal?! That's 
amazing!

You caught a flower petal?! That's 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. Something of this level is no trouble 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly feeling like trying it myself, I 
reach out to catch a falling cherry 
blossom petal in midair, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, you must not attack directly 
and recklessly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Do not fight your opponent's momentum—use 
it and overcome them. In other words, 
envelop them with the spirit of 'Ju', of 
gentleness."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"So close! It seems your body is still 
carrying a bit of unnecessary tension."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we take a deep breath and reset 
for a moment? Come, let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhaaaale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? I slipped into my usual training 
mindset without thinking...! Please 
forgive me, when we're supposed to be 
flower viewing!
choice_data_list:
I think a hanami done our way is just 
fine!

I think flower viewing done in our own 
style is just fine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Is that so...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I am relieved. Our purpose today 
is for you to have a good time, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"This, too, is a form of flower viewing. 
Let us continue enjoying catching the 
petals."
choice_data_list: Can you catch them in a row too?
This time, I'll make it a success!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what an interesting experiment. A bit 
of play that doubles as training, I take 
it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"It should also train your explosive power 
and reflexes. Now then... here I come!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Tah! Yah!! Sei! There!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I have returned! And, the 
results are—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
These are splendid results. However, more 
than the number of sheets—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bringing joy to you, Trainer-dono, is the 
greatest accomplishment of all! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what incredible spirit! Then let me go 
over the pointers once more!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is not about seizing, but receiving. 
Rather like scooping it up gently in the 
palm of your hands, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the advice, I intently trace the 
trajectory of the petals...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! A hit on the first try is 
truly splendid!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Yaeno's advice!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am delighted to have been of service! It 
turned out to be a wonderful flower 
viewing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Behold, our way of cherry blossom viewing 
is found!
